title: Back swipe
body:
I’ve used Google Keep for almost 10 years and loved it. I recently moved to iOS, and surprisingly, the app feels much harder to use here. There’s no back swipe, which makes one-handed use really inconvenient. The touch response also feels off. 
I often have to tap twice or hit a very tiny area for it to register. It’s strange for an app that’s supposed to be simple and quick.

I genuinely appreciate Keep and want to keep using it, but the iOS version is making me look for alternatives, which I’d really rather not do. Please improve the usability on iOS. Whatever the limitations are, I hope they can be worked out instead of leaving longtime users stuck.
